lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man hee te man maaniaa naa kichh marai na jaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the mind, the mind is satisfied, and then, nothing comes or goes. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੋਟੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa kot apaar hai milanaa sa(n)jogee ||
lines.translation: The body is the fortress of the Infinite Lord; it is obtained only by destiny.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਵਸਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa a(n)dar aap vas rahiaa aape ras bhogee ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself dwells within the body; He Himself is the Enjoyer of pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਜੋਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap ateet alipat hai nirajog har jogee ||
lines.translation: He Himself remains detached and unaffected; while unattached, He is still attached.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaavai so kare har kare s hogee ||
lines.translation: He does whatever He pleases, and whatever He does, comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਵਿਜੋਗੀ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: har guramukh naam dhiaaeeai lahi jaahi vijogee ||13||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Lord's Name, and separation from the Lord is ended. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu aap akhaaidaa gurasabadee sach soi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! The Lord Himself causes us to praise Him, through the True Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਸਲਾਹ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu siphat salaah hai guramukh boojhai koi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is His Eulogy and Praise; how rare are the Gurmukhs who understand this.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai sach milaavaa hoi ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the True Word of His Bani, by which we meet our True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu karatiaa prabh paaiaa karam paraapat hoi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, chanting Waaho! Waaho! God is attained; by His Grace, He is obtained. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤੀ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatee rasanaa sabad suhaaee ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the tongue is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorai sabad prabh miliaa aaee ||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Shabad, one comes to meet God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡਭਾਗੀਆ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vadabhaageeaa vaahu vaahu muhahu kadhaaee ||
lines.translation: How very fortunate are those, who with their mouths, chant Waaho! Waaho!

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਜਨ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਪਰਜਾ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karahi seee jan sohane tinh kau parajaa poojan aaee ||
lines.translation: How beautiful are those persons who chant Waaho! Waaho! ; people come to venerate them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karam paraapat hovai naanak dar sachai sobhaa paaee ||2||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is obtained by His Grace; O Nanak, honor is obtained at the Gate of the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਕਾਇਆ ਗੜੑ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bajar kapaat kaaiaa gaRh bheetar kooR kusat abhimaanee ||
lines.translation: Within the fortress of body, are the hard and rigid doors of falsehood, deception and pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੂਲੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੀ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਧ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bharam bhoole nadar na aavanee manamukh a(n)dh agiaanee ||
lines.translation: Deluded by doubt, the blind and ignorant self-willed manmukhs cannot see them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਪਾਇ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਲਭਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਭੇਖ ਥਕੇ ਭੇਖਵਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: upaai kitai na labhanee kar bhekh thake bhekhavaanee ||
lines.translation: They cannot be found by any efforts; wearing their religious robes, the wearers have grown weary of trying.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਖੋਲਾਈਅਨੑਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee kholaaeeanhi har naam japaanee ||
lines.translation: The doors are opened only by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and then, one chants the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ ਪੀਆ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: har jeeu a(n)mrit birakh hai jin peeaa te tripataanee ||14||
lines.translation: The Dear Lord is the Tree of Ambrosial Nectar; those who drink in this Nectar are satisfied. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਰੈਣਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa rain sukh vihaai ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the night of one's life passes in peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sadaa ana(n)d hovai meree maai ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! I am in eternal bliss, O my mother!

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har siu liv laai ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, I have fallen in love with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਮੀ ਬੋਲੈ ਬੋਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karamee bolai bolaai ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! Through the karma of good deeds, I chant it, and inspire others to chant it as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa sobhaa paai ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho!, one obtains honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਤਿ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vaahu vaahu sat rajaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, Waaho! Waaho! is the Will of the True Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਧੀ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu baanee sach hai guramukh ladhee bhaal ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! is the Bani of the True Word. Searching, the Gurmukhs have found it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਉਚਰੈ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu sabade ucharai vaahu vaahu hiradai naal ||
lines.translation: Waaho! Waaho! They chant the Word of the Shabad. Waaho! Waaho! They enshrine it in their hearts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਤਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu karatiaa har paaiaa sahaje guramukh bhaal ||
lines.translation: Chanting Waaho! Waaho! the Gurmukhs easily obtain the Lord, after searching.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: se vadabhaagee naanakaa har har ridai samaal ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, very fortunate are those who reflect upon the Lord, Har, Har, within their hearts. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨਾ ਅਤਿ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਨਿਤ ਲੋਭੇ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: e manaa at lobheeaa nit lobhe raataa ||
lines.translation: O my utterly greedy mind, you are constantly engrossed in greed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਫਿਰਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa manasaa mohanee dah dis phiraataa ||
lines.translation: In your desire for the enticing Maya, you wander in the ten directions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਨਾਉ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: agai naau jaat na jaaisee manamukh dukh khaataa ||
lines.translation: Your name and social status shall not go with you hereafter; the self-willed manmukh is consumed by pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਨ ਚਖਿਓ ਫੀਕਾ ਬੋਲਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: rasanaa har ras na chakhio pheekaa bolaataa ||
lines.translation: Your tongue does not taste the sublime essence of the Lord; it utters only insipid words.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਤਾ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa guramukh a(n)mrit chaakhiaa se jan tripataataa ||15||
lines.translation: Those Gurmukhs who drink in the Ambrosial Nectar are satisfied. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਸਚਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j sachaa gahir ga(n)bheer ||
lines.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is True, profound and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਧੀਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: vaahu vaahu tis no aakheeai j gunadaataa mat dheer ||
lines.translation: Chant Waaho! Waaho! to the Lord, who is the Giver of virtue, intelligence and patience.
